# WhatsApp advertising attribution fixtures

Fixture payloads in this directory must be synthetic and contain no real phone number, message body, access token or raw production `ctwa_clid`.

The suite will cover documented Cloud API/coexistence referrals plus Baileys direct, ephemeral, view-once and media wrappers in present, opaque-only and missing states. Opaque `ctwaPayload` and `conversionData` values are hashed for diagnostics and are never decoded or promoted to click identifiers.
